audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 and Levels 4-5 are marked 'Skill' in both layers while whys[2] and whys[3] plainly say Ryze wins them.
audit.why: The mirror audit (audits/top/ryze__swain.json) already flipped those two rows to Ryze on its own side. Leaving them 'Skill' here contradicts both the mirror and this page's own prose.
audit.corrected: phases[2].side / win[2] and phases[3].side / win[3] -> Ryze, ratings to 3/10 (the inverse of the mirror's 7/10).

audit.why: The spike ladder is already honest: Swain's level-1 window, Ryze's 3-5 rotation window, the level-6 stalemate, and Ryze's mana-item spike. Ryze scaling past first item matches the carryRating of 8.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison is described repeatedly as 'His point-blank root'. It is not a root by default.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Unfluxed, Rune Prison is a slow. Spell Flux is what upgrades it, and both are 615 range on an 11s / 3.5s cooldown. Teaching the player to fear a point-blank root gives them no way to defuse it; teaching them the Flux prerequisite does.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux — stay outside 615 or dodge the E and it is only a slow. It is down 11s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json (W text and range 615, cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9; E range 615, cd 3.5)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Overload reaches 1000, nor that Nevermove roots only on its return pass.
audit.why: Overload at 1000 outranges Death's Hand (750) and Nevermove (850), so Ryze can poke from outside every answer Swain has — but his damage rotation needs the 615 step-in for Spell Flux. That step-in is the whole punish window. And Nevermove's root lands on the return trip, so it must be aimed past the target, which changes how the root is set up off a W slow.
audit.corrected: Punish the 615 Flux step-in, not the 1000-range poke; aim Nevermove past him so the return pass catches him.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — breakdown.cooldowns says only 'Bait it'.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and is the ability the whole page is keyed to. Without the number, 'track it' is unactionable.
audit.corrected: State 11s and tie the E-root window to it.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames are false positives: 'Your Demonic Ascension', 'Realm Warp's' and 'With Arcane Mastery' are all correct names flagged only by edit distance against the lowercased canonical string. I did edit whys[3], but for a mechanical reason (Overload's reset comes from its own passive, not from Arcane Mastery), not a naming one.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json (P Arcane Mastery, R Realm Warp, Q passive reset text)
